cohort: Pregnant women registered and delivered, and those who came directly in labor at a tertiary care hospital in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India between January 2010 and December 2019.
finding: The study found a significant reduction in HIV seroprevalence among pregnant women over the decade and an MTCT rate of 4.5% at 6 weeks and 1.8% at 18 months, demonstrating the success of the PPTCT program.
